start: Today page of a gym whose member app and shop are turned on; two new orders, one ready, one handed over today

user_sees: Card titled 'Shop today' with the button 'Open shop'
Three figures: '2' over 'new orders', '1' over 'ready for pickup', a rupee amount over 'sold today'
Each figure shows '…' until the orders have loaded
must_not: A figure of 0 shown before the orders have loaded
An order that was only placed, not handed over, counted in sold today

steps.action: Wait while a member places an order in the app
user_sees: The 'new orders' figure goes up by one within the poll time, in the bright colour
A short message 'New order from <first name> — <amount>'
must_not: The page jumping or redrawing when nothing changed
The same order announced twice

user_sees: The Shop page on its Orders tab, with the same count of new orders
must_not: A different count on the Shop page than on the card

start: Today page of a gym that has not turned the member app on

user_sees: No 'Shop today' card at all
The card 'Let members order from your gym in the MettleUp app.' with the button 'Turn on the shop' instead
must_not: A 'Shop today' card with zeros for a shop that does not exist
An error banner about orders

steps.action: Turn the internet off on a gym with the shop on, then open Today
user_sees: The 'Shop today' card with '…' in every figure, or the last loaded figures
must_not: Zeros shown as if there were no orders
A rupee figure shown as NaN

start: Today page, shop on, one order in each state

steps.action: Mark a new order Ready on the Shop page, go back to Today
user_sees: 'new orders' one lower, 'ready for pickup' one higher
'sold today' unchanged
must_not: The order counted in both figures
Sold today rising before the order is handed over

steps.action: Mark the ready order as collected, go back to Today
user_sees: 'ready for pickup' one lower
'sold today' higher by the order total, in green
must_not: The amount added twice
The amount missing until a reload

steps.action: A member cancels a new order in the app
user_sees: 'new orders' one lower at the next refresh
must_not: A cancelled order still counted as new
A cancelled order counted in sold today

start: Today page, shop on, signed in as the owner

user_sees: The 'sold today' figure is shown because the owner may see money totals
Counts and money of this gym only
must_not: Another gym's orders or money in the figures
Member names or phone numbers on the card itself

start: Today page, signed in as front desk staff, shop on, two new orders and one ready

user_sees: Card titled 'Shop today' with the button 'Open shop'
Two figures only: '2' over 'new orders' and '1' over 'ready for pickup'
must_not: A 'sold today' figure shown to staff
An empty third column left where the money figure would be

user_sees: The Shop page on Orders, the only tab staff has
must_not: A Products tab shown to staff

start: Today page as staff in a gym where the member app is not on

user_sees: No 'Shop today' card
The line 'The member app and shop are not turned on yet. Only an owner can turn them on.'
must_not: A 'Turn on the shop' button shown to staff
A shop card with zeros

start: Today page as staff, shop on, one new order

steps.action: Mark the order Ready on the Shop page, go back to Today
user_sees: 'new orders' 0 in the plain colour, 'ready for pickup' 1
must_not: The bright colour left on a zero count

steps.action: Hand the order over (collected), go back to Today
user_sees: 'ready for pickup' 0
Still only two figures
must_not: The money of the order shown anywhere on the card

start: Today page as staff, shop on, orders handed over today

user_sees: Counts of orders only
No 'sold today' figure and no rupee sign on the card
must_not: The day's shop takings visible to staff on the card
Another gym's order counts
